title: PARDIG: Global Precipitation Estimates Learned from Sparse Satellite Observations
abstract: arXiv:2611.13941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating precipitation at the global scale is vital for Earth system science and disaster response, yet observational coverage and measurement precision remain constrained. Existing solutions provide options that trade off desirable traits such as skill, latency, geographical coverage, temporal coverage, and spatial and temporal resolution. We present PARDIG, an artificial intelligence framework based on a spherical graph-mesh transformer architecture that produces near-real-time global precipitation estimates. PARDIG is trained on dense multi-modal inputs, including atmospheric state analyses and multi-spectral geostationary satellite imagery, to predict sparse, high-precision precipitation measurements from spaceborne radar. translated_title: PARDIG：从稀疏卫星观测中学习得到的全球降水估计
translated_abstract: 全球尺度的降水估计对地球系统科学和灾害响应至关重要，但观测覆盖范围和测量精度仍然受限。现有解决方案需要在理想特性之间进行权衡，例如预报技巧、时延、地理覆盖范围、时间覆盖范围以及空间和时间分辨率。我们提出了PARDIG，这是一个基于球形图-网格Transformer架构的人工智能框架，能够生成近实时的全球降水估计。PARDIG在密集的多模态输入上进行训练，包括大气状态分析场和多光谱静止卫星图像，以预测来自星载雷达的稀疏、高精度降水测量。在推理阶段，训练好的模型以0.1°空间分辨率和15分钟时间分辨率在全球范围内密集应用，生成自2016年至今的完整近实时降水场……
tldr: PARDIG是一个基于球形图-网格Transformer的人工智能框架，通过学习密集多模态观测数据来预测稀疏的高精度星载雷达降水测量，以0.1°空间分辨率和15分钟时间分辨率提供2016年至今的近实时全球降水估计。
en_tdlr: PARDIG is an AI framework based on a spherical graph-mesh transformer architecture that learns from dense multi-modal inputs to predict sparse, high-precision spaceborne radar precipitation measurements, producing complete near-real-time global precipitation fields at 0.1° spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution from 2016 to the present.
